changes.newText: A superadmin can work in the WebUI with another user's permissions. Open the more actions menu in that user's row, select Use as this user, and confirm with Open in new tab.
changes.newHtml: A superadmin can work in the WebUI with another user's permissions. Open the more actions menu in that user's row, select Use as this user, and confirm with Open in new tab.

changes.newText: The new tab runs as that user; click Exit in its banner to return the tab to your own account. Your other tabs keep your admin view, and the audit log records that your admin account performed the actions.
